Clarity bundles these open-source libraries, unmodified:

- Papa Parse 5.4.1 — MIT License — https://github.com/mholt/PapaParse
- @supabase/supabase-js 2.117.0 — MIT License — https://github.com/supabase/supabase-js
- SheetJS Community Edition 0.20.3 — Apache License 2.0 — https://sheetjs.com
  (loaded only when an Excel file is opened)

Full license texts are available at the links above.
